title: 宏观压力下：阿里拼多多核心电商盈利，为何仍能撑住？
speaker: Ellie Jiang

segments.en: Okay, beyond just the internet platforms, what else are you tracking in terms of the earnings side of things?
segments.zh: 除了互联网平台，在盈利方面你还关注什么？

segments.en: Macro is something that you just cannot avoid.
We have all seen all the consumer stocks, all the internet stocks as well.
segments.zh: 我们都看到了消费股和互联网股的表现。

segments.en: Eventually, Macro is not too great.
segments.zh: 最终，宏观环境并不太理想。

segments.en: We're still trying to sort of weather through the ongoing deflationary impact from the global market.
segments.zh: 我们仍在努力应对全球市场持续的通货紧缩影响。

segments.en: The truth is, for the internet names, they tend to be a bit more resilient, just given that they have been around for a very long time.
segments.zh: 事实上，互联网公司往往更具韧性，因为它们已经存在了很长时间。

segments.en: They know how to play the game. In fact, for the likes of Baba, or even PDD, what's surprising is that despite of recent macro headwings, we're seeing their core e-commerce profitability finding a support in the recent earnings.
segments.zh: 它们懂得如何应对。事实上，像阿里甚至拼多多这样的公司，令人惊讶的是，尽管近期宏观逆风，我们看到它们的核心电商盈利能力在最近财报中找到了支撑。

segments.en: So we do think these could be also things that investors track into 2027, where even Macro is bad.
segments.zh: 因此，我们认为这些也可能是市场参与者会追踪到2027年的因素，即使宏观环境不佳。

segments.en: There will always be something to support in terms of how these companies can continue safe.
segments.zh: 总会有一些因素支撑这些公司如何继续保持安全。

segments.en: In terms of their internal expenses, how they can potentially optimize on R&D as well.
segments.zh: 在内部开支方面，它们如何潜在地优化研发。

segments.en: All of that can give you more confidence on earnings particularly in 2027.
segments.zh: 这些都能让你对盈利更有信心，尤其是在2027年。
我看了他们的覆盖范围。
